product_family: Open-source AI workflow platform with agents, automations, apps, and internal tools builder. Supports both cloud (Budibase Cloud) and self-hosted deployment options.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Budibase is ISO 27001 certified and fully committed to ongoing compliance. Underwent rigorous audits performed by independent third-party auditor NQA who evaluated the effectiveness of their ISMS implementation. Certificate viewable on UKAS website.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: All servers are hosted within EU datacenters certified by SOC 1/2 and ISO 27001. This refers to the hosting provider's certifications, not Budibase's own SOC 2 certification. No direct evidence of Budibase company-level SOC 2 Type II certification found.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliant. Terms of Service function as a data processing agreement under Article 28 of EU GDPR and UK GDPR, with Budibase acting as Data Processor and customers as Data Controllers.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Per the Terms of Service: 'The Subscription Services are not designed to comply with industry-specific regulations such as the US Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA), or the Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) ... so Customer may not use the Subscription Services where Customer's communications would be subject to such laws.' Separately, Budibase marketing and blog content references 'HIPAA readiness' and 'guardrails', though this language does not appear in the binding Terms of Service.

flags: Marketing claims 'SOC 1/2 certified' and the homepage mentions 'enterprise-grade security,' but this appears to refer to the datacenter provider's certifications, not a Budibase company-level SOC 2 Type II certification.

The Terms of Service state that services are not designed for HIPAA compliance, yet enterprise marketing mentions 'HIPAA-ready features' and 'HIPAA readiness,' which could confuse healthcare customers about actual compliance status.
Product positioning emphasizes privacy-first AI and data sovereignty, but there is no explicit statement confirming customer data is never used for model training.
No dedicated trust center page exists despite ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance claims; security information is scattered across the homepage, the /security/ page, and documentation.
